700250_hitter.text: Forty-five projected home runs from a first baseman who walks 12.0% of the time and barely chases is a profile that doesn't need a favorable park to work. 700255_pitcher.text: Jacob Steinmetz is a 22-year-old A+ pitcher showing modest strikeout production (8.4 K/9) paired with concerning walk rates (3.9 BB/9) in his 57.7 innings this season. 700321_hitter.text: Andy Perez is a left-handed hitter with an elite batting average (.312) and contact rate (13.1 K%) that translates to strong pitch recognition at the plate, but his power output is a significant concern—an ISO of .092 sits in the 17th percentile and projects to just .104 in the majors, well below the league average of .15. 700731_hitter.text: Keiner Delgado is a contact-heavy, patient hitter whose plate discipline (87th percentile BB%, 89th percentile K%) forms his only clear above-average tool, but he lacks the bat speed or gap power to generate consistent impact—his .118 ISO projects well below league average and sits at just the 35th percentile.
